rawContent: "We're here because of @TaranaBurke started a movement." Michelle Williams credits the #MeToo founder for helping her daughter to grow up in a safer world. Credit where credit is due! #TimesUp #GoldenGlobes

If only dudes at the #GRAMMYs felt as passionate about supporting #MeToo and  #TimesUp as @adrock did when he used his acceptance speech for Best Hip Hop Video at the 99 VMAS to speak out against the sexual assault that went down at Woodstock that year. https://t.co/V7VZk68vMd
